metadata.title: Groupicorn Georgia IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Local provider groups are considered before named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings. September 22, 2026 parallel regional pass added current official or accreditation-backed sites in Athens, Augusta, Columbus, Macon, and Savannah; Metro Atlanta and the remaining regional hubs were not statewide re-verified.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url uses repository-provided provider brand assets where available. Brand assets are discovery references and have not been license-cleared for redistribution.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.

areas.name: Atlanta core / Midtown / Buckhead / Brookhaven
areas.example_cities: Atlanta | Midtown | Buckhead | Brookhaven | Sandy Springs
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Atlanta is split from its north, northeast, and south suburban treatment markets because traffic and provider clustering make them practical separate catchments.

areas.name: Athens and Northeast Georgia
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Athens is a standalone university and regional market. Serenity Grove provides one verified local group; additional local programs remain to be researched.

areas.name: Augusta and Central Savannah River Area
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Augusta is a standalone cross-border regional hub. Georgia Recovery Campus and Kindle provide current local evidence; this state-specific package does not silently add South Carolina providers.

areas.name: Macon and Middle Georgia

areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Macon serves a large central-Georgia region. Georgia Recovery Campus provides one current local group; additional Middle Georgia programs remain to be researched.

areas.name: Columbus and Southwest Georgia

areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Columbus is a standalone west-Georgia hub. Georgia Recovery Campus provides one current local group; cross-border Alabama programs are outside this state-specific package.

research_queue.name: Savannah and Coastal Georgia
research_queue.task: Recheck Memorial Health's Savannah behavioral-health IOP/PHP and search additional independent and hospital programs beyond Samba and Coastal Behavioral Health.

research_queue.name: Augusta and Central Savannah River Area
research_queue.task: Verify the current public-facing Augusta program page for Georgia Recovery Campus and expand with Lighthouse Care Center, Hope House, and other local providers where current physical-site IOP/PHP evidence is available.

research_queue.name: Macon and Middle Georgia
research_queue.task: Expand beyond Georgia Recovery Campus with current official IOP/PHP evidence for HealthQwest, hospital programs, and realistic Warner Robins or Milledgeville options.

research_queue.name: Columbus and Southwest Georgia
research_queue.task: Recheck New Horizons Behavioral Health day-treatment and substance-use intensive outpatient services for a current qualifying physical site, then search additional Columbus programs.

research_queue.name: Athens and Northeast Georgia
research_queue.task: Expand beyond Serenity Grove with additional current adult, adolescent, and university-connected IOP/PHP programs in Athens and nearby regional hubs.

research_queue.name: All Georgia locations
research_queue.task: Run an audited geocoding pass and record coordinates plus coordinate sources; this research pass intentionally leaves coordinates null.
